fieldEvidence.fact: Criterion identifies Cronos as a 1993 film from Mexico, in Spanish, 93 minutes; credits Guillermo del Toro as director and Federico Luppi and Ron Perlman in the leading roles.

Rotten Tomatoes matches Cronos (1993), describes Jesús Gris finding a scarab that restores youth but causes a thirst for blood, and lists director Guillermo del Toro, Federico Luppi and Ron Perlman. It classifies the film as horror.
The Morelia festival catalog lists Cronos as a 1993 Mexican film, names production companies Prime Films and Producciones Iguana, and records the 1993 Mercedes-Benz Critics' Week award at Cannes.

The Argentina page matches Cronos (1993), displays age rating 16, duration 1h34, Mexico, Guillermo del Toro, and the cast including Federico Luppi and Ron Perlman. The stored +16 is the catalog's normalized label for its displayed 16.

The current Argentina JustWatch page says Cronos streams on MovistarTV; the same-day JustWatch GraphQL result in international-remaining-justwatch.json matched title Cronos, year 1993, and reported FLATRATE twice for provider MovistarTV (technical name movistarplay), checked 2026-11-06T22:30:26.170Z. MovistarTV is not a represented catalog label, so the movie uses the allowlisted Otras plataformas label by itself.

Rotten Tomatoes lists Cronos (1993) at 69% Popcornmeter with 10,000+ audience ratings. Normalize round(69/10)=7; no confidence reduction or 9/10 masterpiece cap applies. Final CinePosta score: 7. Retrieved 2026-11-06.

The selected Cronos theatrical poster is available at https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/3BadFDdGuuCMblH9jQwNwfcxhrF.jpg (967x1451 JPEG). Visual inspection confirmed the Cronos title, del Toro credit and scarab artwork with no added award badge or third-party watermark. Localized to public/assets/posters/1993/cronos-1993.webp.

YouTube oEmbed returned the exact title 'CRONOS - 4K Restoration Trailer' and author JANUS, channel https://www.youtube.com/@janusfilmsnyc. This is an official restoration trailer, not represented as the original 1993 trailer.
